adjudication.rationale: The finding is accurate. Looking at lines 1871-1879 in handleNewBooking.ts, when creating a booking record, only `evt.destinationCalendar[0].id` is connected to the booking's destinationCalendar field. However, earlier in the code (around line 1060-1068), the evt.destinationCalendar is populated as an array that can include multiple calendars for collective team events (line 1073 shows `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). When the booking requires confirmation or payment (deferred scheduling), only the first calendar is persisted to the database, losing the other team members' destination calendars. This means when the booking is later confirmed or payment succeeds, the calendar events won't be created for all collective team members.
